# MixDeR - Current Version: 0.10.0

MixDeR (**Mix**ture **De**convolution in **R**) is a workflow (with a
Shiny app) for performing mixture deconvolution of ForenSeq
Kintelligence SNP data for two-person mixtures using
[EuroForMix](https://github.com/oyvble/euroformix/) and creating
GEDmatch PRO reports for the individual contributor SNP profiles.

This method requires extensive validation of the settings. MixDeR
provides the option of calculating various metrics for evaluating the
accuracy of the deduced SNP genotypes. This is extremely useful when
determining settings, specifically the allele 1 probability threshold,
the allele 2 probability threshold, and the minimum number of SNPs.

*Note: MixDeR (and EFM) assume the mixture samples are composed of two
contributors. MixDeR is able to identify and alert the user to samples
that may be potentially either single source or consist of a mixture
with a large mixture ratio (i.e. \> 1:100 ratio between contributors).
In these scenarios, the user is warned to be cautious with the minor
contributor inferred genotyping results.*

MixDeR version 0.8 and later provides the option to perform ancestry
prediction using principal component analysis (PCA). Additional
information can be found below in the **Ancestry Prediction** section.

The MixDeR paper can be cited with the following:

``` R
Mitchell, R., Peck, M., Gorden, E., & Just, R. (2025). MixDeR: A SNP mixture 
deconvolution workflow for forensic genetic genealogy. Forensic Science 
International: Genetics, 76, 103224, doi: 10.1016/j.fsigen.2025.103224
```

## Usage

To launch the shiny app:

``` R
library(mixder)
mixder()
```

To use the command line, please see the R API page in the MixDeR
documentation.

Please see [MixDeR
documentation](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/bioforensics.github.io/mixder/)
for further information.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`check_allele_probabilities()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/This.md)
  : Checks EFM predicted genotypes for errors
- [`add_rows()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/add_rows.md)
  : Add SNPs to ensure same SNPs are present in both samples for a
  replicate analysis.
- [`ancestry_1000G_allsamples`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/ancestry_1000G_allsamples.md)
  : 1000 Genomes genotypes for 10,030 autosomal SNPs for all 2,504 1000G
  samples
- [`ancestry_colors`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/ancestry_colors.md)
  : Colors for creating 3D PCA plots
- [`ancestry_prediction()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/ancestry_prediction.md)
  : Ancestry prediction using PCA
- [`ancestrysnps_1000G_allsamples`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/ancestrysnps_1000G_allsamples.md)
  : 1000 Genomes genotypes for 54 ancestry SNPs for all 2,504 1000G
  samples
- [`assigned_A2()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/assigned_A2.md)
  : Calls allele 2 based on established threshold
- [`calc_metrics()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/calc_metrics.md)
  : Calculating metrics for a single set of allele 1 and allele 2
  probability thresholds
- [`calculate_at()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/calculate_at.md)
  : Calculate the analytical threshold
- [`centroids()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/centroids.md)
  : Centroid Calculations and Plotting
- [`check_3_or_4_col()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/check_3_or_4_col.md)
  : Adds additional columns if necessary to data frame to ensure same
  number of columns between sample and replicate
- [`check_allele_calls()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/check_allele_calls.md)
  : Checks EFM predicted genotypes for errors
- [`check_nas()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/check_nas.md)
  : Checks if entire column has NA values
- [`check_ratios()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/check_ratios.md)
  : Check the mixture ratios for potentially single source samples (or
  samples with very high mixture ratios)
- [`check_reads()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/check_reads.md)
  : Check SNP sets if all SNPs have 0 reads
- [`checking_af()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/checking_af.md)
  : Checking AF file for correct format; formatting if necessary
- [`compile_metrics()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/compile_metrics.md)
  : Compiling metrics for the range of allele 1 and allele 2 probablity
  thresholds
- [`create_at()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/create_at.md)
  : Create AT table containing only SNPs contained in the evidence file
- [`create_config()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/create_config.md)
  : Create configuration file containing all settings for a specific run
- [`create_evid()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/create_evid.md)
  : Create evidence files for EFM mixture deconvolution
- [`create_evid_all()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/create_evid_all.md)
  : Creating SNP sets from evidence samples containing all SNPs
- [`create_gedmatchpro_report()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/create_gedmatchpro_report.md)
  : Create GEDmatch PRO report
- [`create_replicatedf()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/create_replicatedf.md)
  : Creates replicate df
- [`decode_freq_name()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/decode_freq_name.md)
  : Convert frequency file name
- [`equalize_samples()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/equalize_samples.md)
  : Equalize samples when using replicates
- [`filter_alleles()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/filter_alleles.md)
  : Filters the called genotypes based on the allele 1 and allele 2
  probability thresholds
- [`fix_columns()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/fix_columns.md)
  : Identifies if one sample has more columns than another; adds columns
  as needed.
- [`format_af()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/format_af.md)
  : Formatting allele frequency files for use in EFM
- [`format_ref()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/format_ref.md)
  : Formatting reference file
- [`gedmatch_metrics()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/gedmatch_metrics.md)
  : Calculate various metrics on the inferred genotype dataset to assist
  user in evaluating the final dataset
- [`get_ids()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/get_ids.md)
  : Get Reference IDs from either CSV file or Sample Reports
- [`kintelligence_snp_positions`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/kintelligence_snp_positions.md)
  : Kintelligence SNP positions file
- [`load_freq()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/load_freq.md)
  : Load in frequency data
- [`load_kin_older()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/load_kin_older.md)
  : Formatting Kintelligence Sample Reports created with UAS version
  \<2.5
- [`load_kin_uas25()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/load_kin_uas25.md)
  : Formatting Kintelligence Sample Reports created with UAS version 2.5
- [`mixder()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/mixder.md)
  : Run MixDeR
- [`popFreq_1000G`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/popFreq_1000G.md)
  : Allele Frequency file using 1000G Phase 3 dataset
- [`popFreq_AFR`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/popFreq_AFR.md)
  : Allele Frequency file using 1000G Phase 3 dataset for all AFR
  individuals
- [`popFreq_AMR`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/popFreq_AMR.md)
  : Allele Frequency file using 1000G Phase 3 dataset for all AMR
  individuals
- [`popFreq_EAS`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/popFreq_EAS.md)
  : Allele Frequency file using 1000G Phase 3 dataset for all EAS
  individuals
- [`popFreq_EUR`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/popFreq_EUR.md)
  : Allele Frequency file using 1000G Phase 3 dataset for all EUR
  individuals
- [`popFreq_SAS`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/popFreq_SAS.md)
  : Allele Frequency file using 1000G Phase 3 dataset for all SAS
  individuals
- [`popFreq_gnomad`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/popFreq_gnomad.md)
  : Allele Frequency file using gnomADv4 dataset
- [`process_efm_files()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/process_efm_files.md)
  : Process files created by EFM
- [`process_kinreport()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/process_kinreport.md)
  : Function to determine how to create the AT file
- [`processing_evid_sample_reports()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/processing_evid_sample_reports.md)
  : Creating usable data frame from a Kintelligence Sample Report
- [`processing_ref_sample_reports()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/processing_ref_sample_reports.md)
  : Processing Reference Sample Reports
- [`read_in_table()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/read_in_table.md)
  : Read in dataset to run through EFM
- [`reverse_comp()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/reverse_comp.md)
  : Identifying SNPs that need to be reverse complemented
- [`run_efm()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/run_efm.md)
  : Running mixture deconvolution in EuroForMix
- [`run_indiv_efm_set()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/run_indiv_efm_set.md)
  : Running individual EFM SNP sets in parallel
- [`run_mixder_ancestry()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/run_mixder_ancestry.md)
  : run MixDeR using the CLI; ancestry prediction
- [`run_mixder_metrics()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/run_mixder_metrics.md)
  : run MixDeR using the CLI; calculate validation metrics
- [`run_mixder_report()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/run_mixder_report.md)
  : run MixDeR using the CLI; create GEDmatch PRO report(s)
- [`run_workflow()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/run_workflow.md)
  : Run MixDeR workflow
- [`snpinfo`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/snpinfo.md)
  : SNP information json file
- [`write_tables()`](https://bioforensics.github.io/mixder/reference/write_tables.md)
  : Write metrics tables
